description: This file defines a Java interface for reading device registration data within a self-service portfolio component of the Fineract project. It declares methods for retrieving all device registrations, a registration by ID, and by client ID.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationReadPlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface for reading device registration data, providing methods to retrieve device registration information.

methods.name: retrieveAllDeviceRegiistrations
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all device registration data entries.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegiistration
methods.description: Retrieves device registration data for a given registration ID.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegiistrationByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves device registration data associated with a specific client ID.
